neowiki-model-bundles-description: Installs, updates and exports model bundles: NeoWiki schemas, layouts, mappings and subjects carried from one wiki to others in one file.
neowiki-bundle-file-not-json: The file is not valid JSON.
neowiki-bundle-file-empty: The file holds no schemas, layouts, mappings or subjects.
neowiki-bundle-file-section-not-object: The "$1" entry of the file is not an object.
neowiki-bundle-file-invalid-metadata: The "bundle" entry of the file needs a "name", and its "version" and "description" must be text.
neowiki-bundle-file-duplicate: The file holds $1 twice, under two spellings of its name.
neowiki-bundle-file-schema-no-property-d: The $1 schema in the file has no "propertyDefinitions" object.
neowiki-bundle-file-invalid-schema: The $1 schema in the file is not valid: $2
neowiki-bundle-file-invalid-layout: The $1 layout in the file is not valid: $2
neowiki-bundle-file-invalid-mapping: The $1 mapping in the file is not an object.
neowiki-bundle-file-invalid-subject: The entry $1 under "subjects" is not a subject: it needs a subject ID as its key, a "schema" and a "statements" object.
neowiki-overview-datamodel-description: Browse schemas, layouts and mappings by the model bundle they came from.
neowiki-data-model-intro: This wiki's schemas, layouts and mappings, grouped by the model bundle that installed them, with the subjects each bundle brought.
neowiki-bundle-url-not-web: Enter a full URL, starting with http:// or https://.
neowiki-bundle-url-unreachable: The file could not be read from that URL. Its server may not let other websites read it. Download the file and choose it under "From a file" instead.
neowiki-bundle-url-failed: The URL answered with HTTP status $1.
neowiki-bundle-other-bundle: This file holds model bundle $1, not $2.
neowiki-bundle-name-help: Wikis tell model bundles apart by name. Use the same name to update this one later.
neowiki-bundle-name-unusable: A model bundle name cannot be empty or too long, nor contain # < > [ ] | { } /, ~~~, an HTML entity such as &, or a % followed by two hexadecimal digits.
neowiki-bundle-updates: This wiki has version $1 of this model bundle.
neowiki-bundle-updates-unversioned: This wiki has this model bundle, without a version.
neowiki-bundle-status-differs: Differs from the version on this wiki. Importing replaces that version.
neowiki-bundle-status-differs-install: Differs from the version on this wiki. Installing replaces that version.
neowiki-bundle-status-changed-both: Changed in the model bundle and on this wiki. Updating replaces the changes made on this wiki.
neowiki-bundle-status-deleted-here-chang: Deleted on this wiki, and changed in the model bundle since. Updating creates it again.
neowiki-bundle-status-removed-upstream: No longer in the model bundle. Updating removes it from this wiki.
neowiki-bundle-page-title-taken: Its page title is taken, so it will be created on page $1.
neowiki-bundle-conflict-unreadable: Its version on this wiki could not be read: $1
neowiki-bundle-conflict-dependence: Whether its subjects are dependent cannot change.
neowiki-bundle-conflict-subject-schema: Its ID is taken by a subject of the $1 schema.
neowiki-bundle-conflict-id-in-use: The ID $1 is taken by another subject on this wiki.
neowiki-bundle-conflict-dependent-schema: Its dependent subjects are of the $1 schema, which this wiki does not have as a schema of dependent subjects.
neowiki-bundle-remove-blocked-referenced: Kept: other subjects point to it.
neowiki-bundle-remove-blocked-unreadable: Kept: its version on this wiki could not be read: $1
neowiki-bundle-record-failed: The items above were written, but model bundle $1 could not be recorded as installed: $2. Install the file again to finish.
neowiki-bundle-export-dependent-subjects: Its subjects come with their host subjects.
neowiki-bundle-export-adds-schemas: Also exports the $1 {{PLURAL:$2|schema|schemas}} of their dependent subjects.
neowiki-bundle-export-metadata-help: Name the export to make it a model bundle, which wikis install and later update. Without a name it is a plain export.
neowiki-bundle-export-unreadable-subject: Failed to read the subjects of the $1 schema.
